newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods backs Q2 $0.26/shr estimate.
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods backs Q2 $0.26/shr estimate.

text.p: Michael Foods Inc Chief Executive Officer Gregg Ostrander said he is "generally comfortable" with analysts' estimates that the company will earn $0.26 a share for the second quarter.

"The Street consensus is for about $0.26, against $0.20 a year ago, and we're generally comfortable with where the Street is," Ostrander told Reuters before the food processor's annual meeting here late Thursday.
The estimates exclude a charge the company will incur as it completes its exit, announced in March, from the frozen french fry business by selling off its remaining inventory.
Ostrander agreed with Michael Foods Assistant Treasurer Mark Witmer that the charge would reduce second quarter earnings by $0.02 to $0.03 a share, after reducing first quarter earnings by $0.03.
Ostrander also backed First Call's mean earnings estimate of $1.00 a share for the full year 1997, excluding charges for exiting the frozen french fry business.
"I like an even buck (EPS) for the year," Ostrander said. "We're generally comfortable with where the Street is, but the year-end is a long way off."
In 1996 Michael Foods earned $0.74 a share, excluding a $0.90 charge relating to exiting the frozen french fry business.
